page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, 32.0 GB of system memory, and a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The server is equipped with an exceptionally large local storage capacity of 23,622 GB utilizing HDD technology, managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.d1.2xlarge is positioned in the lower tiers for compute and memory speed. Stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests place it in the bottom 25%, while single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression fall into the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show weak read performance at 37.11 GB/sec for large blocks, though large block write performance reaches an average tier at 34.88 GB/sec. Passmark CPU scores are average, but database operations and Redis SET benchmarks remain in the bottom 25%.

The primary tradeoff of this server is its reliance on older CPU architecture and slower HDD storage, which limits its suitability for high-performance computing or low-latency transactional databases. However, the massive 23.6 TB local storage capacity provides significant resource density for cold data storage, large-scale data archiving, and sequential data processing where storage volume is prioritized over random I/O speed. It is best suited for distributed file systems, data warehousing, log aggregation, and batch processing workloads.
